source_of_truth: Canape, roving and slider service-size standards inferred from Riviera built-in canape recipes and Kuschi-approved service-variant patterns. Base rules remain riviera_data/service_variants.json.

cocktail.portion: 1 bruschetta per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 pieces as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Assemble in 20-piece batches no more than 15 minutes before pass. Keep crostini, beef and cream separate for staggered service.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate service only. Assemble close to handover; do not hold fully assembled more than 15 minutes.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 pieces as optional premium finish.

buffet.reason: Crostini softens quickly once topped with cream and beef. Use roving canape or immediate platter service instead.

corporate_boxed.reason: Bread loses crunch and beef/cream quality drops in sealed boxed holding. Use sandwich or roll formats for corporate delivery.

cocktail.portion: 1 small crab cannoli per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Finger lime pearls or extra micro herbs as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Fill 5-10 minutes before service. Do not pre-fill more than 30 minutes out and never stack filled shells.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Chilled immediate-service platter only. Fill close to pickup/service and send in single layer.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Finger lime pearls or micro herbs as optional premium finish.

buffet.reason: Seafood filling softens cannoli shells quickly and creates high chilled seafood holding risk. Use roving or immediate platter service.

corporate_boxed.reason: Filled shells soften in sealed boxes and chilled seafood quality is too fragile for normal corporate delivery.

cocktail.portion: 1 prawn brioche slider per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Potato crisp or micro herbs as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Assemble no more than 12 minutes before pass. Keep prawns dry and slaw well drained.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate service only. Toast bun cut-side and assemble close to handover.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Potato crisp or micro herbs as optional premium finish.

buffet.reason: Wet prawn cocktail mix and slaw soften brioche quickly. Use roving/substantial canape or ordered platter service instead.

corporate_boxed.portion: not recommended for corporate boxes unless specifically ordered
corporate_boxed.reason: Brioche and seafood filling quality drop quickly in sealed boxes. Use only when client specifically orders sliders and timing supports quality.

cocktail.portion: 1 smoked chicken and bacon brioche slider per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp bacon crumb as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Assemble in batches of 20 no more than 15 minutes before pass. Bacon must be crisp at assembly.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate service or short delivery only. Keep bacon separate until final assembly where practical.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or crisp bacon crumb as optional premium finish.

buffet.reason: Assembled brioche softens and bacon loses crispness during open buffet holding. Use roving canape or platter service instead.

corporate_boxed.reason: Brioche and bacon texture decline in sealed boxed holding. Use filled brioche roll or sandwich formats for standard corporate boxes.

cocktail.portion: 1 vintage beef brioche slider per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or premium pickle garnish as optional finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Cook in rolling batches and pass immediately. Do not hold assembled sliders.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate service only. Cook and assemble as close to handover as possible.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or premium pickle garnish as optional finish.

buffet.reason: Smash patties and brioche lose quality quickly once assembled. Use roving/substantial canape or immediate platter service.

corporate_boxed.reason: Hot beef sliders do not hold well in sealed boxes. Use only with client-specific order and protected delivery timing.

cocktail.portion: 1 mini beefburger canape per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Extra microgreens or truffle aroma refreshed at pass as premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Cook in batches of 8-10 and serve immediately. Wagyu fat sets quickly; do not hot-hold assembled.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate service only. Not suitable for long delivery or standing hold.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Extra microgreens or truffle aroma refreshed at pass as premium finish.

buffet.reason: Mini burgers lose heat and texture too quickly for open buffet holding. Use roving canape or immediate platter service.

corporate_boxed.reason: Wagyu mini burgers are quality-sensitive and unsuitable for sealed boxed delivery.

cocktail.standard_garnish: champagne mignonette served beside or spooned to order
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Finger lime or micro herbs as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Serve chilled on ice. Mignonette beside the oyster or spooned at pass, not pre-drowned.

tapas.premium_garnish_option: Finger lime or micro herbs as optional premium finish.

platter.service_rule: Chilled immediate service on ice. Label raw seafood clearly and keep shellfish separate from other platters.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Finger lime or micro herbs as optional premium finish.

buffet.portion: not recommended unless built as a staffed oyster station or seafood fountain item
buffet.reason: Raw oysters require controlled cold holding, ice, service monitoring and clear allergen management. Use staffed station or platter service only.

corporate_boxed.reason: Raw oysters are not suitable for standard boxed corporate delivery due cold-chain, shellfish and quality risk.

cocktail.portion: 1 stuffed mushroom per guest · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or beetroot powder as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Serve warm. Dot aioli and garnish at pass only.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

buffet.portion: 1 stuffed mushroom per guest service target · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
buffet.service_rule: Hold warm dry, uncovered where possible. Garnish and aioli at service, not before holding.
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or beetroot powder as optional premium finish.
buffet.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.service_rule: Immediate warm platter. Send aioli separate for hot delivery or dot at handover.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or beetroot powder as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.reason: Warm mushrooms release moisture and soften in sealed boxes. Use only for immediate service or controlled hot platter delivery.

cocktail.portion: 1 prawn with chorizo per guest on spoon · Riviera 9% event buffer applies once
cocktail.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or restrained green herb powder as optional premium finish.
cocktail.service_rule: Fire-to-pass canape. Cook in batches of 10-12 prawns and pass immediately. No hot holding.
cocktail.buffer_rule: Apply the Riviera 9% event buffer once to the unbuffered service target.

platter.portion: count by ordered spoons/pieces for immediate service only
platter.service_rule: Immediate staffed service only. Not suitable for pre-built delivery platters.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or restrained green herb powder as optional premium finish.

buffet.reason: Prawns become rubbery within minutes and the dish is designed as fire-to-pass spoon service. Use roving canape or staffed action station.

corporate_boxed.reason: Hot prawns and chorizo are not suitable for boxed delivery; texture and food safety risk are too high.

cocktail.portion: not recommended until tomato-based spec is deliberately approved or substituted
cocktail.reason: Built-in recipe flags heirloom tomato as a Kuschi exclusion/review item. Use roasted capsicum and caramelised onion, whipped goats cheese with pickled shallot, or another approved vegetarian crostini instead.

platter.portion: not recommended until tomato-based spec is deliberately approved or substituted
platter.reason: Built-in recipe flags heirloom tomato as a Kuschi exclusion/review item and crostini softens quickly after topping.

buffet.reason: Tomato mix releases liquid and crostini softens quickly. The recipe also requires review before confirmation due tomato exclusion note.

corporate_boxed.reason: Wet tomato bruschetta is unsuitable for boxed delivery and the tomato-based spec requires deliberate approval before use.

buffer_policy.note: High Tea and Sunday Tapas have no automatic event buffer. Fixed High Tea, platter and corporate modules are not buffered unless an event-specific source says otherwise.
